top_choice_rationale: IceCube (P002) rewards a discovery that nature supplied and nobody predicted in detail: a diffuse TeV-PeV astrophysical neutrino flux, seen in several independent IceCube channels and backed by later source associations (TXS 0506+056, NGC 1068, Galactic plane). It opens a new window on cosmic-ray origins, and the Halzen, Spiering, Karle allocation stays within three names and is defensible. Weaknesses are real: confirmation is across channels rather than across detectors, and the credit cut from a large collaboration and the DUMAND/Baikal/AMANDA lineage is a judgement. I still rank it above the optical lattice clock (P001), which has a clean two-name allocation and a sound mechanism but is a measurement invention in a lineage already prized in 1989, 2005 and 2012, with the SI redefinition pending. P001 is a clearly acceptable second; an award of some kind beats no award (P000).
